logline: A baby piglin catches a gold ingot that falls from the sky, four hundred so far, and doesn't know why; it's saving them for a bastion of its own and thinks the guy up there who keeps sending gifts is its biggest fan. When he gets sad, it looks down to find out why: his box is empty, and all the gold he sent is up here with it. It's stuck in his barter farm, and babies never barter.
question: why tf does gold keep falling on this baby piglin?
premise: In the Nether by the Portal Cottage's portal, a player (the original `barter_player` skin) built a barter farm: a dropper drops one gold ingot every six seconds onto a one-piglin cell, the piglin barters, the hoppers carry the barters to a chest. A baby piglin chased an ingot down the farm's catch hole and landed in the cell. It thinks the cell is its room, the gold is a gift from a generous stranger, and it is saving up for a bastion of its own, for when it's big.
twist: The baby is the jam in the player's barter farm. Babies take gold and never barter (they keep it), so the farm has made nothing: every fix the player tried (a new hopper, a PLEASE WORK sign) the baby read as a present. The reveal is SAID over the picture: the baby looks down and says what it sees, 'All the gold he sent was up here, with ME.' (the farm's output chest open and empty under the hopper line, the slumped player at it, the baby above hugging gold); the dropper clicks out another: 'Four hundred and ONE.' Fans' second layer: baby piglins never grow up, so 'for when I'm big' never comes.
payoff_note: `drop`: the stunt mark when the next ingot lands in the baby's arms in S11, on 'ONE' (L13); the dropper clicked ~0.5 s before. The Short ends <= 1.0 s after it. No line after L13.

A netherrack shelf over a lava lake under a netherrack cliff; the portal that formed when Grandpa walked through (day ~175) on the shelf; the player's barter tower built against the cliff about 10 blocks east; a bastion remnant across the lake (unsurveyed: the build places it with /place structure if the seed has none in the footprint).
world.canon: Not Buh's story; nobody from the Portal Cottage appears. The player is a new, nameless player (`barter_player` skin, conflict 18). He finished the farm on day ~4998; the baby was its first catch, so the chest has never had anything in it. The piglins crowd this shelf because a gold ingot comes out of the portal every night (Grandma's, Gold for the Portal): that is why he built here. Never said. The baby never grows up (vanilla).

lines.text: In my world, / gold falls / from the SKY. / Four HUNDRED so far. / And I don't know WHY.
lines.say: In my world, gold falls from the sky. Four hundred so far. And I don't know WHY.
lines.direction: proud and amazed, quick; the number lands, then a real little puzzle on WHY

lines.text: The grown-ups / STARE at me. / They're just / JEALOUS.
lines.say: The grown-ups stare at me. They're just JEALOUS.
lines.direction: a smug little giggle, not scared at all

lines.text: I'm saving up / for a whole BASTION. / For when / I'm BIG.
lines.say: I'm saving up for a whole bastion. For when I'm BIG.

lines.text: A guy up there / threw the first one. / I beat EVERYONE / down the HOLE.
lines.say: A guy up there threw the first one. I beat everyone down the HOLE.
lines.direction: proud of winning, quick and bouncy

lines.text: Now he keeps / sending MORE. / I think he's my / biggest FAN.
lines.say: Now he keeps sending more. I think he's my biggest FAN.

lines.text: He gave me / a shiny / new BOWL.
lines.say: He gave me a shiny new BOWL.

lines.text: And a NOTE. / I can't READ, / but I think it says / WELCOME HOME.
lines.say: And a note. I can't read, but I think it says welcome HOME.

lines.text: The grown-ups / give their gold AWAY. / For GRAVEL. / I'd NEVER.
lines.say: The grown-ups give their gold away. For gravel. I'd NEVER.
lines.direction: a tiny scoff, very superior, hugging its ingot on NEVER

lines.text: But my biggest fan / got SO sad. / I had to / find out WHY.
lines.say: But my biggest fan got so sad. I had to find out WHY.
lines.direction: the first worry in its voice, small, then determined on WHY
fed up, flat, staring into a box

lines.text: So I looked DOWN, / past my / shiny bowl.
lines.say: So I looked down, past my shiny BOWL.

lines.text: All the gold he sent / was up here, / with ME.
lines.say: All the gold he sent was up here, with ME.
lines.direction: plain and puzzled, just saying what it sees; no gasp, no understanding
a happy little automatic count as it catches it, cosy
